name: [3D] Gaussian Splat Artifacts
nl: Splat-reconstruction rendering: surfaces built from overlapping translucent blobs, furry silhouettes and smeared thin geometry, floating stray splats in mid-air, view-dependent colour shimmer, cgi style image.
negative: clean solid geometry, crisp silhouette edges

name: [3D] PSX Horror Lo-Fi
nl: Fifth-generation horror rendering: low triangle counts with warped affine texturing, vertex jitter, dense distance fog swallowing the far plane, muddy dithered palette under harsh point light, game art style image.

name: [3D] Mode 7 Pseudo-3D
nl: Mode-7 rendering: a flat bitmap plane warped into perspective, texels stretching enormous towards the horizon, hard scanline banding, flat sprite objects pasted over the top, game art style image.

name: [3D] Billboard Sprite 2.5D
nl: Billboard-sprite rendering: flat pre-drawn sprites always facing the camera inside blocky level geometry, hard pixel edges against textured walls, banded light sectors, no vertical look, game art style image.

name: [3D] Machinima Capture
nl: In-engine capture rendering: game assets staged for camera with the interface switched off, stiff canned poses, aliased edges and compressed capture artefacts, engine fog and flat ambient, game art style image.

name: [3D] Avatar Platform Shot
nl: Social-platform avatar rendering: mismatched shader styles in one frame, toon-shaded forms beside glossy PBR props, blown-out bloom, mirror-surface reflection and floating UI-free emptiness, cgi style image.
negative: unified art direction, physically consistent lighting

name: [3D] Blocky Sandbox Toy
nl: Blocky sandbox rendering: chunky primitive bodies with cylinder limbs, plastic studded surfaces, flat bright palette, simple baked shadows on a wide open plane, game art style image.

name: [3D] Source-Era Shooter
nl: Mid-2000s engine rendering: bump-mapped brick and rusted metal, orange-grey palette, hard lightmapped shadows baked in place, low-poly props with sharp silhouette corners, game art style image.
negative: modern global illumination, soft volumetric light

name: [3D] Metaball Blob
nl: Metaball rendering: soft spheres merging into one continuous skin, necks pinching where forms separate, glossy wet-looking surface, studio gradient behind with a single soft key, cgi style image.
negative: faceted hard-surface modelling, matte flat shading

name: [3D] Displacement Terrain
nl: Procedural terrain rendering: ridged noise displaced into endless ranges, erosion channels repeating at every scale, thin atmospheric haze stacking towards the horizon, cold directional sun, cgi style image.
